account.title: Your data
account.description: Download a copy of what Saqina holds about you, or delete your account.
account.exportBody: A JSON file with your profile, memberships, what you wrote and your activity. Keys and tokens are never included.
account.deleteBody: This removes your account, sessions, keys, notifications and projects only you belong to. What you wrote in shared projects stays, without your name. This cannot be undone.

ai.title: Generated by AI. It can be wrong: check it before relying on it.

whiteLabel.title: White label
whiteLabel.linkBody: Whether your client portal may carry your own brand, and why it is open or locked.
whiteLabel.intro: White label is locked by default. It opens only with a paid plan that includes it, or a written agreement signed by both parties.

how.title: How it opens
how.body: Branding the portal as your own is a licence to use the Saqina service under another name, so it needs a basis that both sides can point to.
how.paidPlan: A paid plan whose terms include white label. The record names the plan.
how.agreement: A written agreement signed by Saqina and your organization (a reseller or white-label agreement). The record names the agreement's reference number.
how.closes: It closes again when the plan or the agreement ends or is breached, when it is revoked, or when its end date passes. Closing never deletes anything: the portal shows the default Saqina brand again.

status.title: Status of your organizations
status.none: You do not belong to an organization yet.

why.never_granted: Locked: no paid plan or agreement has opened it.
why.revoked: Locked: it was closed. A new plan or agreement opens it again.
why.expired: Locked: the end date has passed. Renew the plan or the agreement to open it again.

rules.title: What the policy says once it is open

may.name: Portal name
may.email_sender: Sender and brand name on email to clients
may.issuer_details: Letterhead, legal name and tax number on invoices and documents

never.abuse_contact: How to report abuse or a security problem
never.team_area: The team area: it is always Saqina

rules.readPolicy: Read the full white label policy

admin.title: Open or close white label (platform owner)
admin.body: Open it only after a paid plan that includes it, or an agreement signed by both parties. Record which one: the reference is shown to the organization.
admin.referenceHint: For example a plan code, or the agreement's reference number such as AGR-2027-004.
admin.validUntilHint: Leave empty for no end date. The end date itself is still open.
admin.granted: White label is open for this organization.

brand.title: Brand
brand.intro: Your name, logo and colour on the client portal, on emails to your clients, and on invoices, receipts and contracts. The staff area always stays Saqina.
brand.locked: Brand settings open when white label is open for your organization.
brand.logoHint: PNG or JPEG, at most {kb} KB, between 32 and 1600 px. It is shown on a light background.
brand.brandNameHint: Shown to clients in place of Saqina. It cannot imitate the platform.
brand.legalNameHint: Printed as the issuer on invoices, receipts and contracts. Leave empty to use the brand name.
brand.accentHint: Used for buttons and the focus ring on the portal. It must stand out from the dark page and carry readable button text.
brand.emailFromNameHint: Clients see this as the sender. The address stays the verified Saqina one.
brand.readOnly: Only an owner or admin can change the brand.

errors.generic: The brand could not be saved. Check the fields and try again.
errors.imitation: The brand name cannot contain the platform name.

accent.lowOnPage: This colour is too dark to stand out on the portal. Pick a lighter one.
accent.lowText: No text colour reads well on this colour. Pick one that is lighter or darker.

logo.tooLarge: The logo is larger than 200 KB.
logo.type: Use a PNG or JPEG file.
logo.dimensions: The logo must be between 32 and 1600 px on each side.
